mission: Observe the exact craft-868x release companion scene, capture terrain/water, and perform a bounded ordinary movement check.
neutral_observation: The initial original shows a broad blue water surface in the foreground and a water channel ahead, grassy dirt voxel banks on both sides, bright sky/clouds, and a dark translucent Rusty CraftSurvive debug/control panel in the upper-left. The panel visibly lists WASD and mouse controls, buttons, and live rope state text. After one 800 ms W hold, the second original remains visually near-identical at this framing; water, banks, sky, panel, and text remain visible. Input delivery completed, but the image pair does not establish a visible movement effect.
acceptance_mapping: The exact release companion scene loaded and visibly retained terrain and water. Page errors were absent. W input was attempted through the ordinary input path; no visible camera/world change is claimed from the original pair.
